links.note: The rules followed in a family and a neighbourhood and why they matter - this concept is where the chapter treats such practices as rules though rarely written down, and says that all families and individuals within the community have specific duties or the community will not function smoothly.
Whether some rules are unfair to a few people in the family or community is verbatim one of this concept's closing questions. Already linked and correct.
Describing several situations where community support makes a difference is verbatim the last of this concept's closing questions. Already linked and correct.
A nuclear family limited to a couple and their children, and sometimes one parent and children - this concept's definition, which allows for a single parent without treating it as an exception.

Most Indian languages having no word for cousin because cousins are only brothers and sisters, which emphasises the deep bonds among all the children in the family - this concept's argument from an absence. Already linked and correct.

Relationships among family members based on love, care, cooperation and interdependence - this concept's opening sentence, and interdependence is the word it says the chapter will reuse of communities. Already linked and correct.
Parents being responsible for raising their children to become happy individuals and responsible members of society - this concept's sentence.
Dana glossed as giving, among the four values the family teaches - ahimsa, dana, seva and tyaga - all listed in this concept.
Tyaga glossed as sacrifice - this concept's fourth value, followed by the observation that individuals often give up their own needs for the family's.

Shalini settling for a simple cotton dress so her uncle's family could have new clothes, and Acchamma explaining that this is how families support each other - this concept's story. Already linked and correct.
Tenzing's father joining in the housework after his mother became busy in the handicraft cooperative - this concept's redistribution of tasks. Already linked and correct.

Tenzing's grandfather active in social work in the colony, registering complaints and collecting money for a neighbour's repairs - this concept's detail, which carries the chapter across from family to community. Already linked and correct.
Tenzing's parents discussing special expenses together and his mother saying they should save for unexpected needs - this concept's closing lines. Already linked and correct.
A group of connected people called a community - this concept's definition, where families are connected with other families and the people around them. Already linked and correct.
The halma tradition of coming together to support any individual or family in times of crisis - this concept's definition of it. Already linked and correct.
Shri Mahesh Sharma of the Shivganga movement and the Padma Shri in 2019, for the tree planting and water conservation work with the Bhils - this concept's account. Already linked and correct.
Private groups, in particular spiritual and religious organisations, cooking and distributing food during the Chennai floods of 2015 - this concept's example. Already linked and correct.

Residents Welfare Associations depending on the trading community for supplies and on municipal workers to handle waste - this concept's own illustration that communities are ultimately interdependent.
A jati, or a subdivision of it, also often called a community - this concept's first example of how flexible the word is. Already linked and correct.
A joint family having several generations living together against a nuclear family limited to a couple and their children - this concept's pair of definitions. Already linked and correct.
Matching mausi to mother's sister against bua, chacha and tau - all four Hindi terms come from this concept's list, and its point is that one word in the mother tongue often needs several in English.
The family as a school where children learn dana or giving - this concept's list of values, and its point that they are learned through daily practice rather than instruction.

The visible statement is that grandparents share wisdom and stories, which is this concept's grandmother, who always has all sorts of interesting stories to tell, with humour and wisdom. The item's other numbered statements are missing from the stem.
Cooperation glossed as working together - this concept's gloss. Already linked and correct.
Halma as the tradition of coming together to support any individual or family in times of crisis - this concept's definition. Already linked and correct.
The teacher's observation that the children had no benches or quiet classrooms and yet paid full attention - this concept quotes it. Already linked and correct.
Kerala's scientific community among this concept's examples of communities formed around a religion, region, common work or interest. Already linked and correct.
Cousins being only brothers and sisters in Indian languages - this concept's explanation for the missing word.

A joint family's several generations living together, against the couple-and-children nuclear family, is what makes pooling resources possible - this concept's pair of definitions. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.

A neighbourhood group organising drives together is a community at work - this concept defines a community as a group of connected people who come together for various reasons and take on duties within it.

The false pair makes a Residents Welfare Association a creature of the national government; this concept describes RWAs as communities that make their own rules, with the residents participating in making them. Already linked and correct.

A village rule requiring each family to contribute grain to a common granary is this concept's material - agreed practices on shared resources, giving secure access but requiring specific duties of every family. Already linked and correct.
